Exemptions may be altered or repealed
exceptions: except those exempting real or personal property used exclusively for religious, educational or charitable purposes as defined by law and owned by any corporation or association organized or conducted exclusively for one or more of such purposes and not operating for profit

review.plain: The legislature shall provide for supervising, reviewing and equalizing tax assessments, which shall never exceed full value. It may provide for village taxes to be collected by other taxing authorities and for counties to advance unpaid village taxes to villages.
limits: Assessments shall in no case exceed full value

provisions.what: The legislature shall provide for the supervision, review and equalization of assessments for purposes of taxation
Assessments shall in no case exceed full value
forbids: Assessments exceeding full value

provisions.what: Nothing in this constitution shall be deemed to prevent the legislature from providing for the assessment, levy and collection of village taxes by the taxing authorities of those subdivisions of the state in which the lands comprising the respective villages are located

Nor from providing that the respective counties of the state may loan or advance to any village located in whole or in part within such county the amount of any tax which shall have been levied for village purposes upon any lands located within such county and remaining unpaid

review.plain: Intangible personal property not used in business is deemed located at the owner's domicile for taxation; trust property is not located here just because the trustee is, except for death taxation in some cases. Intangibles shall not be taxed ad valorem or by ownership excise, and undistributed profits shall not be taxed.
limits: Intangible personal property shall not be taxed ad valorem
nor shall any excise tax be levied solely because of the ownership or possession thereof
Undistributed profits shall not be taxed

provisions.what: Moneys, credits, securities and other intangible personal property within the state not employed in carrying on any business therein by the owner shall be deemed to be located at the domicile of the owner for purposes of taxation
If held in trust, such property shall not be deemed to be located in this state for purposes of taxation because of the trustee being domiciled in this state
exceptions: provided that if no other state has jurisdiction to subject such property held in trust to death taxation, it may be deemed property having a taxable situs within this state for purposes of death taxation

provisions.what: Intangible personal property shall not be taxed ad valorem nor shall any excise tax be levied solely because of the ownership or possession thereof
forbids: Taxing intangible personal property ad valorem
Levying any excise tax solely because of the ownership or possession thereof
exceptions: except that the income therefrom may be taken into consideration in computing any excise tax measured by income generally

provisions.what: Undistributed profits shall not be taxed
forbids: Taxing undistributed profits

review.plain: Where the state has power to tax corporations incorporated under the laws of the United States, it shall not discriminate in tax rates and method between them and similar corporations doing similar business in the state.
limits: there shall be no discrimination in the rates and method of taxation

provisions.what: There shall be no discrimination in the rates and method of taxation between corporations incorporated under the laws of the United States and other corporations exercising substantially similar functions and engaged in substantially similar business within the state
forbids: Discrimination in the rates and method of taxation
conditions: Where the state has power to tax corporations incorporated under the laws of the United States

review.plain: All salaries, wages and other compensation, except pensions, paid to officers and employees of the state and its subdivisions and agencies shall be subject to taxation.

provisions.what: All salaries, wages and other compensation paid to officers and employees of the state and its subdivisions and agencies shall be subject to taxation
